nodes.summary: For elements $a$ and $b$ of a monoid and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the alternating word of length $n$ starting with $a$ is the product $a b a b \cdots$ of $n$ factors that alternate between $a$ and $b$, beginning with $a$; for $n = 0$ it is the identity.
nodes.title: Alternating word

nodes.summary: Let $M = (m_{ij})_{i, j \in B}$ be a Coxeter matrix over an index type $B$, where $m_{ij} = 0$ encodes $m_{ij} = \infty$. The Artin group (Artin–Tits group) of $M$ is the group presented by generators $s_i$, one for each $i \in B$, subject only to the braid relations: for every ordered pair of distinct $i, j \in B$ with $m_{ij} \neq 0$, the alternating words $s_i s_j s_i \cdots$ and $s_j s_i s_j \cdots$ of length…
nodes.title: Artin group

nodes.summary: Let $M = (m_{ij})$ be a Coxeter matrix over an index type $B$, and write $s_i$ for the free generators of the free group on $B$. For $i, j \in B$, let $u$ and $v$ be the alternating words $s_i s_j s_i \cdots$ and $s_j s_i s_j \cdots$ of length $m_{ij}$. The Artin relator of the ordered pair $(i, j)$ is the element $u v^{-1}$ of the free group; setting it equal to $1$ imposes the braid relation $u = v$.
nodes.title: Artin relator

nodes.summary: Let $M = (m_{ij})$ be a Coxeter matrix over an index type $B$, where $m_{ij} = 0$ encodes $m_{ij} = \infty$, and write $s_i$ for the free generators of the free group on $B$. The set of Artin relators of $M$ consists of the elements $u v^{-1}$ of the free group, one for each ordered pair of distinct $i, j \in B$ with $m_{ij} \neq 0$, where $u$ and $v$ are the alternating words $s_i s_j s_i \cdots$ and…
nodes.title: Artin relators of a Coxeter matrix

nodes.summary: Let $M = (m_{ij})$ be a Coxeter matrix over an index type $B$, where $m_{ij} = 0$ encodes $m_{ij} = \infty$, and let $s_i$ ($i \in B$) be the generators of the Artin group of $M$. For distinct $i, j \in B$ with $m_{ij} \neq 0$, the alternating words $s_i s_j s_i \cdots$ and $s_j s_i s_j \cdots$ of length $m_{ij}$ are equal in the Artin group.
nodes.title: Braid relations in the Artin group

nodes.summary: For a Coxeter matrix $M$ over an index type $B$, the subgroup of the Artin group of $M$ generated by its generators $s_i$, $i \in B$, is the whole group.
nodes.title: The generators generate the Artin group

nodes.summary: Let $f : G \to H$ be a homomorphism of monoids. For all $a, b \in G$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, $f$ maps the alternating word $a b a \cdots$ of length $n$ starting with $a$ to the alternating word $f(a) f(b) f(a) \cdots$ of length $n$ starting with $f(a)$.
nodes.title: Monoid homomorphisms preserve alternating words

nodes.summary: For a Coxeter matrix $M$ over an index type $B$ and $i \in B$, the generator $s_i$ of the Artin group of $M$ is the image of the free generator $i$ under the quotient map from the free group on $B$ onto the Artin group.
nodes.title: Generators of the Artin group

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
